description: Pretty excited about this hackathon because it is my first.
summary: I developed a website to address the challenge I chose. My challenge was "Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars". I wrote about the various instruments, rovers, landers, probes, etc, used by NASA for its discoveries aimed to educate children and adults alike and hence honoring those instruments for their service.
details: I made a website to solve my challenge. Used html to code and published the final draft through my GitHub account. I hope this help educate children as well as adults about the various NASA instruments that made wondrous discoveries for us. I first thought of just making a pdf file but then later changed it to a website which I think is a great improvement and helped me know about web building and publishing too.
